One effective-dated version of the chosen schedule (vendor-doc correction; feature since 2020). entity_single, required, depends_on fee_schedule_id, options_source lookup:fee_schedule_effective_dates (04 13.3, FLT-09) = distinct fee_schedule_entries.effective_date of the schedule. Captured default 01/01/2020 is tenant data; candidate first_option. Check on the live tool: list order and whether the default is the earliest, the latest, or the version in force today. The version list is the entry dates: the fee in force is decided by fee_schedule_entries.effective_date and a new effective date is a dated bulk upsert into the same schedule (codes.py FeeSchedule, FEE-4); schedule rows with parent_schedule_id are separate schedules of the FEE SCHEDULE list, not versions.

dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: EFFECTIVE DATE offers the effective-dated versions of the chosen schedule; one version is selected.
dynamic_rules.new_behavior: fee_schedule_effective_date (entity_single) has options_source lookup:fee_schedule_effective_dates (04 13.3, FLT-09) with depends_on [fee_schedule_id]: the list holds the distinct fee_schedule_entries.effective_date values for the chosen schedule. When fee_schedule_id changes the form reloads the list and resets the value to its default (candidate first_option, unconfirmed); a value that is not a version of the chosen schedule is 422 invalid_parameter. Both parameters are required. The run prices every listed code with the entry of that schedule in force on the chosen date (effective_date <= :fee_schedule_effective_date < coalesce(effective_to, infinity)). The hidden office_scope (default all) is a no-op until RPT-STLIST-20: fee_schedules.office_id is deprecated and NULL, so every readable schedule is offered.
